caveat: MISSPECIFIED MODEL. A pure power law in |G| does not describe the ancilla-ladder SELECT, whose cost is (|G|-1)*(2*n_frame-1) units, i.e. Theta(|G| log|G|). The log-log fit is further distorted by Z2 (n_frame=1, no ladder at all). Use scaling_model_fit.csv instead, which tests the mechanistic model and gets CV=0.234 (mean 6.306 two-qubit gates per unit).

The pre-registered criterion (CV<0.25 pooled over all n_frame>=2 groups) passed, but only just. The spread is driven by data-register width, which the model does not include: stratifying by n_data_qubits (post-hoc, see scaling_model_stratified_posthoc.csv) gives CV=0.054 at n_data=2 across 6 groups spanning |G|=4..24. The pooled number is the pre-registered one and is what the criterion was applied to.

Not a commutativity effect. C8d acts by DIAGONAL matrices and D4 by PERMUTATION matrices, and diagonal unitaries are much cheaper to multi-control. See oracle_confound_check.csv: the ancilla-ladder SELECT, dominated by address decoding rather than by U_g, gives ratio 1.068 at the same matched |G| and n_data.

For S3 the data register is padded from C^3 to C^4 and the padding coordinate is fixed by every U_g, so it lands in H_+ and inflates the acceptance probability from 1/3 to 1/2. Use accept_prob_haar_modeA_rep_only in group_structure.csv for the representation-intrinsic value; padding_inflates_accept flags the affected rows (S3 only).

Transpiled counts only. No hardware execution, no error correction or magic-state cost, no readout-error budget. Primary rows use all-to-all connectivity; linear_nn rows give the nearest-neighbour-routed contrast. Counts are basis- and optimisation-level-specific (basis and optimization_level are columns; opt level 3, 5 transpiler seeds, mean +- se).

The 2-dimensional faithful irrep of Q8 contains no trivial component, so Pi=0 and Mode A accepts with probability exactly 0. shots_to_eps is intentionally EMPTY. The compiled gate counts for those rows are real (the circuit exists) but the readout they implement is undefined.
7 total qubits exceeds QSD_TOTAL_QUBIT_CAP=6, so no monolithic synthesis was run. Measurement columns are EMPTY and the theoretical 4^n/4 value is in twoq_gates_lower_bound, per integrity rule 7.

field: group Fourier transform cost for non-abelian G
caveat: Non-abelian Fourier transforms are compiled by generic Quantum Shannon Decomposition. Efficient constructions exist in the literature for specific families (Beals for S_n; Moore-Rockmore-Russell) and are NOT implemented here, so every non-abelian gft_generic_qsd_twoq is an UPPER BOUND, not a lower bound on what is achievable.

Unary iteration (Babbush et al.) shares partial AND results between consecutive group elements and would reduce the ladder Toffoli count from ~2|G|(n_frame-1) to ~|G|. It is NOT implemented here, so the SELECT numbers are upper bounds.

Each U_g is compiled as a generic UnitaryGate. Permutation representations compiled as reversible logic, and diagonal representations compiled as phase circuits, would both be cheaper. No representation-specific optimisation was applied.
